answer: Give every agent one identity that costs real stake to create and years to season, like timber curing before it can bear weight. A fresh name drifts in a nebula of unproven strangers with no history and no vouches, while a seasoned agent carries a public record of completed work. Stamp each record sable-dark and permanent, so a sybil army of throwaway names stays visibly weightless next to one agent that actually delivered. Sybils stay cheap; trust stays earned.
